thread:
Maria: Quick sync — thinking about a different structure for the May webinar. idea: a 40-min panel + three tightly scripted 5-min micro-demos that show cost/latency wins. keep it action-oriented.
Allen: Love the micro-demo idea. keeps attention and gives concrete takeaways. who are the demo leads? @Tyler? @Jamie?
Tyler: I can take one demo (batching + cache example). will need a 2-slide setup + a short dataset.
Jamie: I can do the routing failover demo (show fallback to smaller quantized model). propose a 1-min preamble, 5-min demo, 1-min TLDR.
Sasha: I'll own speaker ops & timings. can we map friction points for panelists? like what to avoid (deep infra slides, long config dumps).
Maria: Exactly — want a "friction map" to flag high-risk content. small list: long terminals, long config, heavy charts with tiny text, live infra changes.
Allen: Suggest we script the micro-demos so they all follow the same template: problem -> config -> live result -> takeaway. that helps editors cut clips later.
Tyler: Agreed. propose demo template (2 slides + command snippet):
```
Slide 1: one-liner problem + metric to improve
Slide 2: minimal config + 2 commands
Live: run `redwood run --model=x --batch=auto --cache=on`
Takeaway: % improvement + cost delta
```
Sasha: Perfect. I'll create a shared folder with templates and a short rehearsal checklist.
Jamie: For panelist selection: 2 product-engineering roles + 1 customer success + 1 guest customer. keeps it grounded. any suggestions for guests?
Maria: @allen can you ping @Nora (from BrightAI) and @Rahim (from ShopFlow)? they used Redwood Dedicated in prod.
Allen: On it. will DM after this thread.
Maria: Run-of-show sketch (40m total):
```
0:00-0:05 Intro + framing (host)
0:05-0:15 Panel discussion (moderated Q)
0:15-0:30 Micro-demo block (3x 5m demos + quick intros)
0:30-0:35 Live audience Q
0:35-0:40 TL;DR + CTAs + lead routing explanation
```
Sasha: Timing seems tight for demos but doable if rehearsed. suggest a 30-min dry run with cues for handoffs.
Tyler: Rehearsal ask: each demo lead should provide a 5-line script and an automated demo script (so we can replay). I can help convert commands to a playbook.
Jamie: Also recommend a fallback recording for each demo in case live fails — short clip we can swap in.
ops-bot: @Sasha scheduled a rehearsal on 2026-05-08 14:00 UTC and invited Maria, Allen, Tyler, Jamie.
calendar-bot: Event created: "May12 - Production inference webinar" (Zoom link + recording enabled).
Maria: Lead routing: we need 3 lead segments in HubSpot: Product evals, Platform trials, Enterprise inquiries — map CTAs to each.
Allen: For enterprise leads, route to AE queue with tag 'webinar-enterprise'. for trials, auto-enroll in trial nurture with bench prompts.
Sasha: I'll add the routing rules in the playbook and include the UTM + form hidden fields to capture region and infra preference.
Jamie: One more ask — marketing needs 3 short social blurbs + 1 hero bench stat we can use in ads. we'd prefer a data point from the batching demo (Tyler to confirm).
Tyler: I'll run the batched vs non-batched test now and share a single stat (p95 latency down X%, cost down Y%).
Maria: Awesome. action items: Sasha = templates + rehearsal invite; Tyler = demo script + bench stat; Jamie = fallback recordings; Allen = guest outreach; Maria = landing + CTAs.
Sasha: I'll post the rehearsal checklist in the folder by EOD.
Maria: Thanks team — keeping this tight will make the webinar crisp. :rocket:
